PAT-1385 P1 fix (round 8, 2026-08-15): download.source was previously the S3 bucket prefix the shell EMITS a downloadURL into (https://p5-downloads.s3.amazonaws.com/awpst), not a queryable resolution endpoint -- resolve strategy vendor-api had no per-vendor implementation for this label, so it was always 'unsupported', never actually verified, while pkg_in_dmg still declared a version-digits template that would ValueError the moment anyone wired up resolution without also wiring up a version (the exact false-alert-on-every-run gap a non-author review found). Fixed by pointing source at the real page Installomator.sh's own archiwareb2go case scrapes for appNewVersion (archiware.com/download-p5, 'ARCHIWARE P5 Version X.X.X - ...') and implementing _resolve_vendor_api_archiware() to read it the same way, hand-verified against the live page and the live S3 object 2026-08-15.
